title: [inbox-proposals 12/19] Add POST /api/proposals/:id/reject
body:
**Blocked by:** #1430, #1843
**Model tier:** medium

## Context

Model tier rationale: A thin custom route over an existing, already idempotent action, following the registration pattern of the confirm route, with the work concentrated in route matrix and tenant-isolation registration.

`rejectProposalWithClient` (`backend/packages/data/src/inbox/proposalActions.ts`) already discards a card without writing a destination: it locks the card, returns an already `rejected` card unchanged, refuses a `confirmed` one with a 400 `validation_failed` (field `status`), appends a history entry ("Rejected by user." or the supplied message) and enqueues the Journal inbox recompute. It has no HTTP route: only `POST /api/proposals/:id/confirm` is registered (`createConfirmProposalRouteHandler` in `backend/packages/data/src/inbox/inboxRouteHandlers.ts`, declared in `inboxModuleManifest.ts`), and a generic `PATCH /api/items/:id` cannot set `status` because that property is system-owned. A client therefore cannot discard a card.

Discarding must work for every card state the user can see: complete, incomplete, needing clarification, invalid, and transcript cards. After a transcript card is discarded its pairing state is derived by #1636 (the list read), and re-creating it after a rerun is prevented by the card's idempotency key; speaker questions are handled by #1640. Approval cards are not Processing proposals and are rejected through `PATCH /api/approval-requests/:id`, which this issue does not change.

This issue builds on #1807 (the card list, whose acceptance criterion about a rejected card disappearing is checked here), #1823 (the count) and #1430 (typed history entries; the history entry written here uses the `rejected` kind). #1852 adds an optional version check, #1937 reopens a rejected card, and #1870 mounts the revise route and relies on the reject route existing.

Decision: the route is a custom route because a reject is a status transition with a history entry and a Journal recompute in one transaction, which the generic item update cannot express.

Shared-file ordering: this issue also waits for #1843 because both edit the same registry, manifest, cutover, route matrix or hook files listed in Touches.

## Task

Load `state-writes`, `error-handling` and `testing`.

1. Add `createRejectProposalRouteHandler(pool)` in `inboxRouteHandlers.ts`: `POST /api/proposals/:id/reject` with optional body `{ message?: string }`, running `rejectProposalWithClient` in one transaction and answering `200` with the card item, shaped like the confirm response.
2. Validate `message` as an optional non-empty string with a sane length cap; reject other body shapes with `validation_failed`.
3. Declare the route in `inboxModuleManifest.ts` `customRoutes` with a justification (status transition plus history plus recompute in one transaction), and export the handler.
4. Add the route to `backend/services/semprec-api/src/routeMatrix.ts` and to `backend/services/semprec-api/src/__tests__/tenantIsolationRoutes.test.ts`.
5. Tests: rejecting a `proposed`, `needsClarification` and `invalid` card closes it; a second call returns the same result; rejecting a `confirmed` card answers 400 `validation_failed` with field `status`; a card of another tenant answers 404; the rejected card no longer appears in `GET /api/inbox/cards`.

## Touches

- backend/packages/data/src/inbox/inboxRouteHandlers.ts (new handler)
- backend/packages/data/src/inbox/inboxModuleManifest.ts (customRoutes entry and export line)
- backend/packages/data/src/inbox/proposalActions.ts (only if the history entry needs the typed kind from #1430)
- backend/services/semprec-api/src/routeMatrix.ts
- backend/services/semprec-api/src/__tests__/tenantIsolationRoutes.test.ts
- backend/packages/data/src/inbox/__tests__/inboxRouteHandlers.test.ts

## Scope

### In scope

- The `POST /api/proposals/:id/reject` route over the existing reject action, with its registrations and tests.

### Out of scope

- The `ifVersion` precondition; #1852.
- Reopening a rejected card; #1937.
- The revise route; #1870.
- Rejecting approval requests, which stays on `PATCH /api/approval-requests/:id`.
- Journal presentation of a discarded item: the existing behavior (the item stays listed with its rejected state) is kept unchanged (decided by the product owner: it stays struck-through as discarded, so it can be brought back).

## Acceptance criteria

- When `POST /api/proposals/:id/reject` is called on a `proposed` card, then it returns 200 with status `rejected`, the card disappears from `GET /api/inbox/cards`, and history gains one `rejected` entry.
- When the same call is repeated, then it returns the same result and history gains no second entry.
- When the card is `confirmed`, then the call answers 400 `validation_failed` with field `status`.
- When the card belongs to another tenant or does not exist, then the response is the same 404.
